description: Execute an i18n key-extraction migration for a web application with 150 components that currently have hardcoded user-facing strings. The migration must follow: identify all hardcoded strings (automated scan + manual review), extract strings to key files (messages.en.json — one key per string, namespaced by component), re-point application code to use the i18n key (replace string literals with t() / formatMessage calls), verify rendering (each component renders correctly with the extracted keys — no missing keys, no broken layouts), and ship. A rollback plan must exist (revert to hardcoded strings). Risk factors: the key-extraction is largely irreversible once the code is refactored (merging back hardcoded strings is expensive), missing keys cause blank UI, and dynamic string construction (string concatenation) doesn't extract cleanly. Tools available: i18next-scanner, formatjs CLI, React i18next, Jest (for rendering tests), ESLint (for hardcoded string detection).
